item.title: Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank has 6mm thickness and 5,000mAh capacity
item.description: Xiaomi has introduced the UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank, a portable accessory designed for space saving. Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power BankPocketable powerbank?The new power bank features a thickness of 6 mm and a weight of 98 g making it one of the slimmest yet in the market. This could be beneficial for use cases such as needing a power bank on your pocket or one that can fit on your ultra-light bag.The accessory attaches magnetically to compatible smartphones and provides wireless charging.
